description: Search NLM MeSH descriptors by a disease/drug/concept term (e.g. "diabetes", "aspirin", "myocardial infarction"). Returns the matching MeSH descriptor IDs (Dxxxxxxx) — the controlled-vocabulary headings used to index PubMed. The core free-text-to-MeSH lookup. Keyless.

match.description: Match mode against descriptor labels: "exact", "contains", or "startswith". Default "contains".

text.description: A disease, drug, or biomedical concept term, e.g. "diabetes", "aspirin", "myocardial infarction".

name: search_descriptors
title: Search Descriptors
